entry.author: NZ On Air Music
entry.summary:
Charlotte Ryan welcomes Māori soul and R&B artist Myshaan, whose music has captured hearts across the motu. His track “Sway” became a TikTok sensation, while “Carry My Heart” has now soared past 8.5 million views on YouTube. Myshaan catches up with Charlotte to share the story of his rise and the places his music has taken him throughout Aotearoa and the Pacific Islands.
